g.title: Long shot. The docks at dawn, in fog. Alice, left, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, right. Caption: Dawn.
Long shot. The docks by day. Alice, left, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, right. Caption: Noon.
Long shot. The docks at dusk. Alice, left, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, right. Caption: Dusk.
Long shot. The docks at night, in the rain. Alice, left, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, right. Caption: Midnight.
